nodes.objective:
Implement TASK-0091 acceptance criteria. 1) In
src/ahra/reference_runner/git_ops.py,
IsolatedGitWorkspaceProvider.finalize_execution_workspace must
remove the isolated worktree directory and prune its git worktree
registration after successful propagation of changes back to the
source, and must retain the worktree when propagation fails so it
stays available for diagnosis. Cover both behaviors with tests in
tests/test_git_ops.py. 2) Add a repository-hygiene test in
tests/test_repo_hygiene.py that fails when any completed task
directory under work/tasks contains a development-worktrees
directory, and passes against the current tree. 3) Create
docs/policies/data-lifecycle.md defining the four task-data
retention tiers - contract (task.md, permanent), authority
(state.json and events.jsonl, permanent but archived after
completion with Git history as audit authority), evidence
(required until EvidenceGate approval, then archived with the
task), run byproducts (runs/ worktrees, sqlite stores, caches:
ephemeral, garbage-collected on success, retained on failure until
the defect closes) - plus the completion-distillation rule: facts
land in docs/, process lands in archive/. Link it from
docs/policies/index.md. Run
uv run python -B scripts/check.py --test and record it in
WorkReport.verification_commands_run.
Verify the worktree GC, hygiene test, and data-lifecycle policy are present and consistent.

spec.rationale:
Self-hosting loop, data lifecycle. Per work/tasks/TASK-0091/task.md:
isolated execution worktrees must be garbage-collected after successful
propagation, a repository-hygiene test must enforce the retention rule,
and docs/policies/data-lifecycle.md must define the four task-data
retention tiers. Declared filesystem.write resources are the
request-scoped allowlist admitted by TASK-0085.
